text:
Maya: Heads up 1 our contractor-to-hire candidate just told me they need to delay start by two weeks due to an early delivery and newborn care logistics. they9re in the EU and will need to return home for ~3 weeks. any special process for contractors converting to FT?

Diego: we treat contractor conversions similar to new hires for benefits eligibility but with a few differences. key Qs: 1) does the candidate currently have an active contractor invoice period that overlaps the new FT start? 2) is the role remote or relocating?

Maya: role is remote US-based but candidate is finishing contracting from Spain. conversion paperwork set for June 1 start, candidate requesting June 1 -> push to June 15 start, travel June 3June 24.

Simone: People Ops note: parental leave pay and company childcare stipend require active employment and, for pay, completion of the 90-day eligibility window. however, for bridging situations we can approve a one-time "care stipend" sourced from the People Ops discretionary fund up to $5k for cases where the start date would otherwise be missed. needs manager signoff + short justification.

Maya: candidate estimates airfare + short-term childcare at $4.2k. manager is Diego and approves pushing start two weeks to accommodate. candidate prefers an advance rather than reimbursement since travel will be booked immediately.

Diego: I approve the two-week start shift. happy to sign off on advance if People Ops ok.

People Ops Bot: New case created: HR-2026-325 by Maya. Status: intake -> pending review. Link: https://redwoodinternal/hr/cases/HR-2026-325

Simone: Process: 1) please ask the candidate to sign the standard conditional advance agreement (will include repayment if candidate declines or fails background). 2) manager needs to confirm start date amendment in writing. 3) finance will issue advance as a one-time payroll deposit.

Maya: attached signed conditional advance (candidate ok), added manager confirmation. candidate also provided a short note confirming partner and expected travel dates.

People Ops Bot: Reminder: Discretionary Care Stipend (code: DC-ADV) terms: max $5,000; approval path: Manager -> People Ops -> Finance; repayment 100% if candidate doesn't start within 45 days of agreed start.

Diego: thanks. will coordinate with recruiting to update offer letter start date and inform candidate.

Simone: note for records 1 if this becomes repeated for the same team we should talk about a regional childcare pool for frequently relocating hires.

Maya: will loop in recruiting if more cases come up. final outcome: will post here once finance issues advance.

People Ops Bot: Case HR-2026-325 updated: approved. Finance queued advance. Expected payment date: 2026-06-01.

Maya: payment confirmed and candidate booked flights. closing thread. :tada:
